strings.text: He was an old man who fished alone in a skiff in the Gulf Stream.
strings.translation: Era un viejo que pescaba solo en un bote en la corriente del Golfo.

strings.text: Fish, I love you and respect you very much. But I will kill you dead before this day ends.
strings.translation: Pez, te quiero y te respeto mucho. Pero te mataré antes de que termine este día.

strings.text: I wish I had the boy.
He is two feet longer than the skiff.
strings.translation: Es dos pies más largo que el bote.
